title: Weil's Theorem for Logarithmic Connections on Irreducible Nodal Curves
summary: We establish an analogue of André Weil's classical theorem for irreducible nodal curves. Let \(X_0\) be an irreducible projective nodal curve. We prove that an indecomposable vector bundle or torsion-free coherent sheaf \(E\) on \(X_0\) admits a holomorphic logarithmic connection \(\nabla\colon E\to E\otimesω_{X_0}\) with respect to the dualizing sheaf if and only if \(°E=0\).
